ACM1.1: Staff with AC-ADMIN creates, edits (description only) and deletes an application (name, id, URL); no approval.
ACM1.2: Staff manages modules under an application.
ACM1.3: Staff manages users of an application.
ACM1.4: Staff manages roles of an application.
ACM1.5: Staff manages functions (with URL) of an application.
ACM1.6: Admin grants roles to a user.
ACM1.7: Admin assigns or unassigns functions to a role.
ACM1.8: AC-SUPPORT validates role grants made by the admin.
ACM1.9: AC-APPROVE approves role grants made by the admin.
ACM1.10: Audit of actions performed in ACM.
ACM1.11: Removal of resigned staff from ACM.
